Class BookArray

java.lang.Object
BookArray
public class BookArray extends Object
A class used for the Runner.ListB() program. Its got some basic functions, its main purpose is for the ability to wrap text by word. The BookArray class has a reference to a Book object when its created, details in the constructor doc.

    • GLBW

      private int GLBW(int median)
      Short for: Get Length By Word
      Parameters:
      median - the upper threshold of the amount of words.
      Returns:
      the index of a String as to where the number will split the String into the most words allowed by the parameters. An example would be: 
       name = "This is a very long text file";
 int b = GLBW(15); // b = 14 so 
 String a1 = name.substring(0,GLBW(15));
 String a2 = "This is a very";
 boolean result a1.equals(a2); //returns true.
      See Also:

      • GLBI()

    • toString

      public String toString(boolean withPercent, int median)
      The big deal for this class, arguably the entire reason the class exists.
      Parameters:
      withPercent - a boolean for if the percent should be added, which is in fact, quite pointless since this method is only ever called with true.
      median - At what point to start wrapping text.
      Returns:
      a singular String to be printed that will represent one book object in the list.
